messages.subject: F0 scaffold done
messages.body: Added the mdtoc package (__init__ with __version__, __main__, argparse cli with FILE+, --check, --stdout, --max-depth), 5 unittest smoke tests written first (failed, then green), and a README Usage section. Branch fleet/build-f0, head 02f12580231e7a5eead9e9f6a26c4acf0ebb9ce0; 'python3 -m unittest discover' ran 5 tests OK and 'python3 -m mdtoc --help' exits 0. main() only validates files are readable UTF-8 (stderr + exit 2 on failure, a small overlap with S3 AC-6e, no aggregation logic beyond a loop); commit used a one-off author 'Claude (Orca worker)' because the VM has no git identity, unsigned, no trailers per global rules; not pushed.
